items.title: Higher direct images are compatible with restriction to an open subspace
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a morphism of ringed spaces, a module F and an open subspace V of the target, with g the restriction of f over the inverse image of V, the lemma shows that the higher direct images of the restriction agree with the restrictions of the higher direct images, and that the same holds for the derived image of a bounded below complex (statement lines 629-642). The author gives two proofs: the first applies the description of higher direct images as the sheaf associated to the presheaf of cohomology on inverse images together with the compatibility of cohomology with restriction to an open; the second chooses an injective resolution and uses that its restriction is again an injective resolution computing the higher direct images on the open (proof lines 644-650). The claim is H2: the second proof is a genuine two-line argument about resolutions, and the author supplies it in addition to the first.
